softwareInnerHero.title: Transform Data into Actionable Insights
paragraphs: Microsoft Power BI is a powerful, interactive business intelligence (BI) and data visualization tool that empowers organizations to connect to disparate data sources, transform raw data into meaningful information, and create compelling, shareable reports and dashboards. It enables users at all levels to gain actionable insights from their data, facilitating informed decision-making and driving business performance.

title.before: Microsoft Power BI empowers businesses and individuals to:

items.title: Connect to Diverse Data Sources
items.body: Seamlessly pull data from hundreds of sources, including cloud services (e.g., Salesforce, Google Analytics), databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle), Excel spreadsheets, web pages, and more, consolidating your data for a holistic view.

items.title: Transform and Model Data
items.body: Clean, shape, and combine data from various sources using Power Query. Build robust data models with relationships and custom calculations (DAX formulas) to prepare your data for deep analysis.

items.title: Create Interactive Dashboards and Reports
items.body: Design intuitive and visually engaging dashboards and reports with a wide array of customizable charts, graphs, maps, and other visualizations. Enable users to drill down, filter, and interact with data to explore insights.

items.title: Discover Insights with AI and Natural Language
items.body: Leverage AI-powered capabilities, such as Quick Insights and natural language Q&A, to automatically identify patterns, trends, and outliers in your data, even without extensive analytical skills.

items.title: Share and Collaborate Securely
items.body: Publish reports and dashboards to the Power BI service (cloud), allowing secure sharing with colleagues, clients, or the wider organization. Control access and distribute information effectively across teams and devices.

items.title: Access Insights Anywhere, Anytime
items.body: Stay connected to your data and dashboards on the go with Power BI Mobile apps for iOS, Android, and Windows, ensuring you have critical business insights at your fingertips.

items.title: Integrate with the Microsoft Ecosystem
items.body: Benefit from deep integration with other Microsoft products like Excel, Azure, and Dynamics 365, creating a unified and powerful analytics environment.
